if: the document is a refund voucher referred to in clause (e) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 51 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the refund voucher MUST carry the amount of tax paid on the goods or services, by head
note: One mandatory particular of rule 51(i), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: amount of tax paid in respect of such goods or services (central tax, State tax, integrated tax, Union territory tax or cess);
